title: Reduced closed subschemes of a nodal curve are nodal, and meet their complement in finite separable spectra at nodes of X
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma controls how nodal singularities restrict to reduced closed subschemes and their scheme-theoretic complement (statement lines 4793-4810). The proof (lines 4812-4859) is a complete case analysis over the irreducible components through each point, with the load-bearing step being the computation in the completed normal form kappa(y)[[u, v]]/(uv) where the two branches become the coordinate projections and the intersection ideal is the maximal ideal (u, v). H2: the case analysis is systematic and each case is short, with one genuine completion computation.
